name: Auger Manufacturing Specialists
hours: Confirm hours on the official site before visiting
description: Frazer manufacturer of augers, conveyor screws, and helicoid flighting for food, chemical, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and plastics plants since 1973.

hero.headline: Auger Manufacturing Specialists
hero.sub: Since 1973 this Frazer shop has built and repaired augers, conveyor screws, and spiral flighting for plants that cannot wait on a new machine.

items: All types, sizes, and lengths of augers, conveyor screws, and helicoid flighting
Vertical auger filler tooling, parts, and accessories
Repair of worn or damaged augers, including bent shafts and added flights
Official homepage dates the company to 1973
Published shop phone 1-610-647-4677 next to toll-free 1-800-544-1199
Address listed as 22A Bacton Hill Rd., Frazer, Pennsylvania 19355
Serves food, chemical, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, and plastics industries

story.heading: About
paragraphs: The official homepage says more than 40 years in the business earned the shop a reputation as a worldwide industry leader.
It focuses on one-at-a-time field replacements and original equipment manufacturers that need the next auger to match the last one.

items: Send a worn or damaged auger and the shop will advise whether repair can save a new-part cost.
Stock accessories and spare parts are listed for All-Fill, Mateer, Bartelt, and related lines.
International inquiries are routed from the official ordering pages.

feature.heading: Repair first when the shaft can be saved
feature.text: The official homepage says the shop can straighten bent shafts, add flights, and take out knicks so a plant does not buy a new auger by default.

spotlight.heading: Two published phones, one shop
spotlight.text: Use 610-647-4677 for the inventory match. The official homepage also publishes toll-free 800-544-1199 for USA and Canada. Confirm which line to use before you call.
